title: dev.qory.run.heartbeat
description: The run is alive. Sent every interval_seconds from the accepted registration until the run's final event, so the start, from the registration to dev.qory.run.started, is covered too, or from dev.qory.run.started when the run has no server; a run is live from its accepted registration until its final event, or until it has no recent heartbeat: none within 3 × interval_seconds, each judged by its own time (README §The server).

elapsed_seconds.description: Seconds since the start of the run's heartbeats: on a session's run, since the session's discovery of its gateway's link; on a run a gateway opened, since the run's registration, or since dev.qory.run.started when the run has no server.

interval_seconds.description: Seconds between heartbeats, so a receiver can detect a missed one.
